panels.headline: Thank you for choosing local
panels.body: Your support keeps independent work personal, human, and close to home.
panels.art_direction: Cinematic single-object cover with a warm citrus palette, deep teal accents, and a soft gold frame. The front is a premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork with a generous margin reserved for the app overlay.
panels.image_prompt: A warm citrus-colored, handmade, local-shop textured, 5x7 premium vertical flat print panel artwork with a generous margin reserved for the app overlay, featuring a small, delicate, golden tea kettle in the center, surrounded by a thin, refined, deep teal border, with a soft gold frame and a quiet, cream-colored background. Flat 2D full-bleed digital illustration. No readable text. No words, letters, handwriting, calligraphy, labels, signatures, or fake text. No people. No hands. No logos. No watermark. Avoid all-over repeating wallpaper patterns; use restrained hierarchy and negative space. No caption plaque, no text box, no inner card rectangle, no blank tag, no label. Not a photo, not a physical paper card, not a folded card mockup, not a tabletop scene, not a product photograph.

panels.headline: Because You Chose Us
panels.body: We're grateful you chose to support a small, independent business like ours. It means the world to us!
panels.art_direction: Border-first stationery design with a calm blank center, a light ivory/cream low-contrast interior, and a thin refined frame. The inside-left is a quiet, polished, and optional panel with a generous margin reserved for the app overlay.
panels.image_prompt: Full-bleed flat 2D artwork layer for a vertical 5x7 inside-left print panel; light ivory or cream low-contrast note-sheet field, border-first stationery layout, thin refined frame, sparse edge/corner or lower-edge motifs, quiet blank center, clean text-safe area, generous safe margins, no inner text box. Warm small-business thank-you stationery: cream or deep teal field, controlled citrus-and-leaf corner arrangement, soft gold ribbon curve, subtle boutique awning silhouette, kraft paper texture, editorial negative space, not busy repeated fruit. Artwork layer only, not a physical card or photographed paper. No caption plaque, no inner card rectangle, no mockup frame, no table, no envelope, no label, no sign, no blank tag, no text box, no shadowed paper sheet. Decorative print borders are allowed. Premium print-ready flat artwork, full-bleed 2D composition, minimal clutter, disciplined negative space, no all-over repeating wallpaper pattern, generous safe margins, no readable text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no handwriting, no calligraphy, no faux script, no fake text, no logos, no watermark. No people. No hands.
